item.title: Community blood drive slated for March 3
item.description: The Riverhead Fire Department will host a community blood drive with the New York Blood Center on Tuesday, March 3 from 1 to 7 p.m. Appointments are preferred, but walk-ins are welcome.

item.title: East End Emerald Society’s Grand Marshal Ball
item.description: The East End Emerald Society will host the Grand Marshal Ball on Friday, March 6 at the Vineyards Caterers, on Main Road in Aquebogue, beginning at 6 p.m.

item.title: Brief burst of heavy snow may cut visibility for morning commute
item.description: A brief burst of snow moving across eastern Long Island Wednesday morning could come down heavy at times, reducing visibility to a quarter-mile or less, according to the National Weather Service in Upton.

item.title: History talk: Long Island women in the American Revolution
item.description: Historian Natalie A. Naylor presents a talk on the experiences and roles of Long Island women during the American Revolution.

item.title: Leprechaun Leap in South Jamesport
item.description: The Leprechaun Leap, a fundraiser for the Jamesport St. Patrick’s Day Parade, will take place on Saturday, March 14 in South Jamesport at 12 noon. item.title: Moderate to heavy snow band reduces visibility across Suffolk through late morning
item.description: A band of moderate to heavy snow continued across Suffolk County late Wednesday morning, reducing visibility to a half-mile or less at times, according to the National Weather Service in Upton.

item.title: Lions Club Annual St. Patrick’s Day dinner
item.description: The Riverhead Lions Club will hold its annual St. Patrick’s Day dinner party with music, bagpipes and dancers. Enjoy a classic St. Patrick's Day dinner of corned beef and cabbage, Irish music, bagpipes, dancers, and a 50/50 raffle. Dinner includes dessert and coffee or tea. (Cash bar.)

item.title: Ukrainian Catholic Church in Riverhead marks fourth anniversary of Russian invasion
item.description: Community members gathered last night at St. John the Baptist Ukrainian Catholic Church in Riverhead for a solemn service marking the fourth anniversary of Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine.

item.title: Former Star Confectionery owner’s second act: making chocolate at Southampton luncheonette
item.description: The former owner of Star Confectionery on Main Street in Riverhead is happily making chocolate candy again. He teamed up with lifelong friend Mark Parash, who owns Sip ’n Soda in Southampton, to produce the chocolate Easter candy that generations of Star Confectionery fans loved.

item.title: Cops: Riverhead man charged with murder in death of his mother
item.description: Suffolk County Police arrested Curtis Trent Jr., 36, of Riverhead and charged him with second-degree murder in the death of his mother, Kathleen Harrison Trent, whose body was found Feb. 11 in a wooded area in Manorville, police said.
